fit.rule: Equal weight to nonempty old/new x start/interior/boundary x reach-target-sign strata; exact original cost/reach labels. Retain component/joint sign loss and per-critic gradient projection. A block has at most four actual optimizer steps. Temporary intermediate regression or sign changes are permitted. At block commit require original five-grid gate, every previously correct start, nonincreasing additional false-feasible and selected boundary mismatch counts. New metrics stay within fixed source-anchored working bounds (relative MAE <= max(source, original limit)*1.05; Pearson >= min(source, original limit)-0.02). These are working guards only, never final criteria. A rejected block restores model, optimizer and sampling RNG, then retries at half LR; every actual step counts. Freeze the first step satisfying the complete unchanged v5 train gate.

train_gate: Call the unchanged v5 train_gate on 540 old plus 432 additional train trajectories. Original numeric limits (relative MAE<=0.35 and required Pearson>=0.70), primary recognition, beta=0, zero false-feasible and all selected boundary signs must pass. Do not dilute old/new errors or replace targets. Preserve full_s2 true primary 17/18 and reject its timeout.
development_gate: Save and CPU-reload all six frozen candidates only after train checks; call the unchanged original evaluator once on all 180 saved development episodes only if all six pass train. Primary 6/6 and zero false-feasible unchanged; publish only through original G4. Repeatedly viewed development is not an independent final test.
failure_policy: Keep all trials and rejected block logs. No automatic restart, leftover-quota reuse/transfer, new rollouts, final/budget_selection access or threshold changes. Exhausted block search or any train failure holds development. This proposal needs separate approval including the working-guard change and new optimizer quota.
protected: beta=0 and final G4/v5 train criteria
